name: Western Australia Aboriginal Ranger Program

administered_by.name: Parks and Wildlife Service, Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions (DBCA)

summary: Competitive grants to Aboriginal organisations that lead ranger programs caring for Country across Western Australia, including land and sea management, fire, weed and feral animal control and restoration work.

status.quote: The ARP provides funding through competitive funding rounds. There are no rounds open at the moment.
